creator: ai_vanta_ai
title: Five plugins for Claude Code / Codex vibe coding: Playwright CLI, Supabase plugin, Strix security agent, SkillUI design-system extractor, Context7 docs

tools.name: Playwright CLI
tools.detail: lets the AI open browsers, screenshot what it built, catch errors (screen: 'agent-browser' terminal '$ playwright... browser')

tools.name: Supabase plugin
tools.detail: builds and manages databases from the terminal

tools.name: Strix
tools.detail: 'Open-source AI hackers for your apps' -- strix.ai, v1.0.4 banner 'Starting Strix Agent'; attacks the app and fixes vulnerabilities

tools.name: SkillUI (npx skillui)
tools.detail: 'Reverse-engineer any design system into a Claude-ready skill. Pure static analysis. No AI. No API keys.' v1.3.3, 2.5k/month downloads, MIT; 'One-shotted Notion's landing page in minutes with a single line prompt'

tools.name: Context7 (upstash/context7)
tools.detail: up-to-date library docs injected into prompts via MCP; screen shows 61.9K stars on GitHub and library list (vercel/next.js, reactjs/react.dev, microsoft/playwright, supabase/supabase, etc.)

claims: Playwright catches messy outputs and errors before you see them
Strix attacks your vibe-coded app like a real hacker and finds/fixes vulnerabilities
SkillUI reverse-engineers a whole design system into a markdown file
Context7 gives the latest version of every library so you never code against an outdated version
how_to_steps: Install the Playwright CLI/MCP for browser verification
Add the Supabase plugin for DB creation/management
Run Strix against your app before launch
Run npx skillui against a reference site to produce a design-system skill file
Add the Context7 MCP so docs are fetched by library ID at prompt time
on_screen_only: '5 CLAUDE CODE PLUGINS' banner with Codex logo
Frontend framework logos React / Vue / Svelte; fast_build_app Supabase-style table UI with categories/dates on 127.0.0.1:8000
STRIX banner: 'Welcome to Strix! v1.0.4 Open-source AI hackers for your apps -- Starting Strix Agent -- strix.ai'; 'api gateway.svc online' and 'exposing endpoints' graphics
SKILLUI README badges: skillui v1.3.3, downloads 2.5k/month, node >=18, license MIT, source npxskillui

Context7 'AI DOCS INJECTION VISUALIZED' diagram: Problem (outdated docs, fake methods, old packages) -> Context7 Hub; Workflow: User Prompt -> Resolve ID -> Query Docs -> Inject Context, MCP Tool; 'It resolves library IDs and queries docs'; '61.9K stars on GitHub'

relevance.why: All five are practical Claude Code add-ons for someone shipping Supabase-backed apps solo; Strix (security) and Context7 (fresh docs) address real failure modes of AI-generated code.

implement_score.why: Playwright MCP and Context7 are minutes to install and broadly useful; Supabase MCP if on Supabase; Strix worth a one-off pre-launch run; SkillUI worth trying on a reference site. Watch token cost of Context7 injections.

verify: Strix: maturity, license, whether it needs its own LLM keys, and whether it is safe to run against production
SkillUI (npx skillui) author and quality of extracted design skills
Context7 free tier limits / rate limits via MCP
Official Supabase MCP vs the 'plugin' meant here
